Rows sa.* (line OF, OF3b): -outfmt 8 (Seq-annot, ASN.1 text), 12 (Seq-annot, JSON) and, in the ids ending .9 (OF3c), 9 (Seq-annot, binary ASN.1: the fixture files are binary, see fixtures/outfmt0/.gitattributes) of BLASTN, BLASTP, TBLASTN, TBLASTX and BLASTX; the BLASTX rows are the manifest's first (check_losat.py runs them with the other programs). Rows sa.*.5 and x5.* (OF4a, OF4b): -outfmt 5 (BLAST XML) of BLASTN, BLASTP (OF4a), BLASTX, TBLASTN and TBLASTX (OF4b; the x5.blastx/tblastn/tblastx rows use the mixed query files tests/fasta/outfmt0/x5_*), the search of an existing row with -outfmt 5 (x5.* where the source is not an sa.* row; x5.e2e.blastp.empty_only_dbsize.0 is the outfmt 0 footer of the same empty-subject search with -dbsize). Freeze them alone with run_oracle.py --freeze --only sa.

# Rows numdesc.* (line NP, O1b): -num_descriptions and -num_alignments (blast_args.cpp:2894-2973); the rows with a warning on stderr (hit list size below 5, -num_descriptions with outfmt 6) record stderr_sha256. Freeze them alone with run_oracle.py --freeze --only numdesc.

# Rows sm1.* (line NP, SM-1): BLASTP -soft_masking true and false (blast_args.cpp:387-391, blast_setup.c:621-624) with -seg yes, -task blastp-fast and -query_loc; the rows with a warning on stderr record stderr_sha256. Freeze them alone with run_oracle.py --freeze --only sm1.

# Rows score.tblastx.* (line NP, series SCT, SC7): TBLASTX -matrix (BLOSUM45, BLOSUM50, BLOSUM62, BLOSUM80, BLOSUM90, PAM30, PAM70, PAM250, IDENTITY; the name is printed as typed in the outfmt 0 epilog and the XML), the matrix's suggested -threshold (+2) and -window_size, explicit values over them, and outfmt 5, 6, 7, 8 and 16. Freeze them alone with run_oracle.py --freeze --only score.tblastx. The -db rows are db.score.tblastx.* in db_search_manifest.tsv; the runs that stop (lower-case names in the XML family, unknown names, IDENTITYX) are tests/tblastx_matrix.rs and the matrix set of docs/evidence/losat_web_e2e/option_sweep.py.

# Rows score.blastp.* (line NP, series SC, SC4a): BLASTP -comp_based_stats 0 (NCBI's ordinary traceback, Blast_TracebackFromHSPList) with -subject, 4 queries (tests/fasta/outfmt0/sc4a_q.faa: the first 3 records of tests/fasta/SicyWSV.faa and, second, a query without hits) against the 86 proteins of tests/fasta/PajaWSV.faa: outfmt 0 (no 'Method:' after the e-value), 5, 7 and 16 (no cbs parameter), blastp-fast, and the spellings that NCBI reads as mode 0 (F, f, 5, x, 0u and the empty value: blast_args.cpp:825-886). The -db rows are db.sc4a.* of db_search_manifest.tsv.

# Rows score.blastp.cbs0_amr.6f, score.blastp.cbs0_q1.6 (drop-in DI-3): AMRFinderPlus's call with -subject and its 10-column tabular report; one query (tests/fasta/outfmt0/sc4a_q1.faa, the first record of tests/fasta/SicyWSV.faa).

# Rows sa.arch.bn.* (line OF, OF8a): -outfmt 11 (BLAST archive, ASN.1 text) of BLASTN with -subject, each with the .8 and .5 rows of the same search (inputs tests/fasta/outfmt11/); freeze them alone with run_oracle.py --freeze --only sa.arch. Batch, reader-error and ARCHIVE_FORMAT cases are tests/outfmt11_blastn.rs (they need environment variables).

# Rows sa.arch.tbn.* (line OF, OF8b2): -outfmt 11 (BLAST archive, ASN.1 text) of TBLASTN with -subject, each with the .8 and .5 rows of the same search (inputs tests/fasta/outfmt11/arch_tbn_*); freeze them alone with run_oracle.py --freeze --only sa.arch.tbn. Batch, reader-error and ARCHIVE_FORMAT cases are tests/outfmt11_tblastn.rs (they need environment variables). -db_gencode other than 1 with -subject is not a row: LOSAT's TBLASTN deviates from NCBI there by design (AGENTS.md, PD-TLOSAN-LOCAL-GENCODE-32); the -db row db.sa.arch.tbn.gc4 has the same search. Rows that only change the recorded option values (-seg yes, -seg '10 1.8 2.1', -comp_based_stats 0, -num_alignments 3, -sum_stats false) are not rows: the unit cases in src/algorithm/tblastn/archive.rs pin the option lists (DECISIONS 46).

# Rows sa.arch.tbx.* (line OF, OF8b3): -outfmt 11 (BLAST archive, ASN.1 text) of TBLASTX with -subject, each with the .8 and .5 rows of the same search (inputs tests/fasta/outfmt11/arch_tbx_*); freeze them alone with run_oracle.py --freeze --only sa.arch.tbx. Batch, reader-error, ARCHIVE_FORMAT and Q3 title cases are tests/outfmt11_tblastx.rs (they need environment variables or a failing run). -db_gencode other than 1 with -subject is not a row: LOSAT's TBLASTX applies it to the local subjects where NCBI does not (outfmt 8 and 5 deviate alike); the -db row db.sa.arch.tbx.gc4 has the same search. Rows that only change the recorded option values (-seg yes, -seg '10 1.8 2.1', -word_size 3, -culling_limit 0, -threshold, -window_size, -evalue) are not rows: the unit cases in src/algorithm/tblastx/archive.rs pin the option lists (DECISIONS 46).

# Rows sm2.* (line NP, SM-2): TBLASTX -soft_masking true and false (blast_args.cpp:387-391, blast_setup.c:621-624) with the default SEG, 4 queries x 4 subjects (sum statistics), a query that SEG covers whole, -query_gencode 4, -query_loc, -seg no and the low-complexity pair of e2d.tblastx.seg31.0 (the lowercase display of the intervals); the rows with a warning on stderr record stderr_sha256. Freeze them alone with run_oracle.py --freeze --only sm2.

# Rows sml.* (line NP, SM-L): TBLASTX -lcase_masking (blast_filter.c:1239-1256, blast_setup_cxx.cpp:320-350 and :813-829, blast_engine.c:816-831) with SEG, -seg no, -soft_masking true, -query_loc, -subject_loc, -query_gencode 4, a query and a subject in lower case whole, two queries; the rows with a warning on stderr record stderr (run_oracle.py --freeze --only sml).
# Run every command from LOSAT/: <program> -query <query> -subject <subject> [-task <task>] <extra_args> -outfmt <outfmt> (0 when the column is empty), output on stdout.
# The Database lines print the -subject argument literally, so the path spelling is part of the expected bytes.
# Expected output: tests/fixtures/outfmt0/<fixture_id>.out, and <fixture_id>.err when stderr_sha256 is set.

# contract approved_db_gencode_deviation: a TBLASTX search with a non-default -db_gencode (AGENTS.md's approved exception); LOSAT must equal <fixture_id>.db.out (NCBI with the subject as a database, db_stdout_sha256) outside the database lines, and differs from <fixture_id>.out only through the subject's genetic code.

# contract approved_punct_title:<stand-in subject>: a subject with hits whose defline is only punctuation that NCBI's x_CleanAndCompress reads past (NCBI crashes in outfmt 0; approved exception 2 of PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS, extended to TBLASTX and TBLASTN, Session S08+). run_oracle.py runs NCBI on the stand-in subject (placeholder deflines) and freezes its report with each placeholder replaced by the title stopped at the end of the string.
# The hash and size columns are written by docs/evidence/losat_web_e2a/run_oracle.py --freeze; do not edit them by hand.
# Rows ps.subj.* (line PS, PS1): psiblast's first round with -subject tests/fasta/PajaWSV.faa (empty task column: psiblast has no -task); freeze them alone with run_oracle.py --freeze --only ps.

# Rows culling.blastp.* and culling.tblastn.* (line NP, O3b): -culling_limit of BLASTP and TBLASTN with -subject; inputs tests/fasta/outfmt0/culling_* (cut from the O3b probe inputs, scripts/probe_o3b.py). Freeze them alone with run_oracle.py --freeze --only culling.blastp. / --only culling.tblastn.

# contract approved_culling_wrap:<limit>: NCBI adds 3 to a -culling_limit above 1 in an Int4 (setup_factory.cpp:338-340), which wraps from 2147483645 on; LOSAT adds in i64 (approved exception, PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS 1.4) and culls nothing, as NCBI does with 2147483644. run_oracle.py runs NCBI with -culling_limit <limit> in place of the row's, and the expected output is that report.

# Rows sa.x16.*, x16.*, sa.blastx.*.1[56], sa.multi.*.1[56], sa.e2d.*.1[56], sa.short.*.15, sa.edge.*.1[56] (OF5a for BLASTP and BLASTN, OF5b for BLASTX, TBLASTN and TBLASTX): -outfmt 16 (BLAST XML2) and 15 (BLAST JSON) of all five programs, the search of an existing row where the covers cell says so; stdout and stderr are NCBI's every byte (the -db rows are in db_search_manifest.tsv).

# Rows sa.x16.tblastx.sub.14, sa.x16.tblastn.sloc.13, x16.blastx.lcase_soft.14, x16.blastx.unsearched.13 (OF5c part 2, TBLASTX, TBLASTN and BLASTX): the same for the programs of part 2, the search of the .16/.15 row of the same stem (the -db rows are in db_search_manifest.tsv; the failed batches and the error cases of these programs are in tests/outfmt13_14_files.rs).

# Rows sa.*.1[34] (OF5c, BLASTP and BLASTN): -outfmt 14 (BLAST XML2) and 13 (BLAST JSON) as side files plus a master file, the search of the .16/.15 row of the same stem. The files column is xinclude: the runner adds `-out <tmp>/<fixture_id>.out`; the master is frozen as <fixture_id>.out (stdout_sha256, stdout_bytes; standard output is empty), the side files as <fixture_id>.out_<n>.xml|json (side_sha256, in order). The old form of a row has 13 cells and no files columns (docs/evidence/losat_web_e2a/run_oracle.py, LOSAT/tests/xinclude_fixtures.py).

# Rows ulp.* (line DBID, item E): BLASTP, BLASTX and TBLASTN -outfmt 8 and 12 of swissprot blastp Query_17 x P01717.2 (tests/fasta/outfmt0/ulp_*: the two proteins and their back-translations), whose Spouge e-value (BLAST_SpougeStoE: score 6558 of the matrix scaled by 32, query length 120, subject length 112) takes NCBI's x87 double rounding of `result *= expl(-z * z) / z;` in ErfC (boost_erf.c:143,171,199,229; LOSAT utils/x87.rs): -dbsize 186063409 (swissprot's letters), and 186063410 for BLASTX, whose gap-decay division hides the 1-ULP difference in the 15 printed digits at 186063409. Freeze them alone with run_oracle.py --freeze --only ulp.

# Rows tfast.* (line DI4, dropin-survey-20261029): TBLASTN -task tblastn-fast and -word_size 5, 6 and 7 (the compressed lookup table, BLOSUM62's), AMRFinderPlus's two tblastn calls (tests/db_search/tfast_amr*: synthetic contigs with AMR genes, README there), other thresholds and windows; freeze them alone with run_oracle.py --freeze --only tfast.

# Rows score.tblastn.* (line NP, series SC, SC1): TBLASTN -matrix, -gapopen and -gapextend over NCBI's tables (BLOSUM45, BLOSUM50, BLOSUM62, BLOSUM80, BLOSUM90, PAM30, PAM70, PAM250, IDENTITY) in composition modes 0 and 2, word sizes 2 to 4, explicit -threshold and -window_size; IDENTITY's reset to mode 0 with a warning for each query of the first query batch (rows with stderr_sha256; identity_batches: 119 queries in 3 batches) in outfmt 0, 5, 6, 11 and 16 (tests/fasta/outfmt0/sc1_q_mix.faa: a record without letters, one with O letters, a query, an all-X query); freeze them alone with run_oracle.py --freeze --only score.tblastn.

# Rows tab.bn.* (line CLI, C2): BLASTN custom tabular reports, -outfmt "6|7|10|20 [delim=X] <fields>" with -subject: every identifier, alignment and taxonomy field, outfmt 7 comment lines, queries without hits, minus-strand and gapped HSPs, the delim= forms, unknown and removed tokens, -query_loc and -subject_loc, dc-megablast and blastn-short (inputs tests/db_search/nslice*.fna, tests/db_search/ids/nucl.fna); freeze them alone with run_oracle.py --freeze --only tab.bn. The runs that stop (the delim=; error, rc 1) are db.tab.bn.* in db_search_manifest.tsv (run_oracle.py cannot freeze a non-zero exit).

# Rows tab.bp.* and tab.bx.* (line CLI, C2, PR 3): BLASTP, psiblast and BLASTX custom tabular reports, -outfmt "6|7|10|20 [delim=X] <fields>" with -subject: every identifier, alignment and taxonomy field (the three groups of tab.bn.*), outfmt 7 comment lines, queries without hits, gapped HSPs, minus frames (BLASTX), the delim= forms, unknown and removed tokens, -query_loc and -subject_loc (BLASTP only: LOSAT's BLASTX refuses them), frames and sframe, psiblast's Iteration line (inputs tests/db_search/ids/ids_q.faa, ids_q.fna, ids_qnone.*, ids/prot.faa (the records of the databases ids/prot_v4, 53 sequences with every Seq-id form), tests/fasta/outfmt11/arch_bp_s.faa, tests/db_search/x16_taxid.faa); freeze them alone with run_oracle.py --freeze --only tab.bp. / --only tab.bx. / --only tab.ps. The taxonomy names are N/A with -subject; the runs that stop and the names of a taxonomy database are db.tab.bp.*, db.tab.bx.* and db.tab.names.* in db_search_manifest.tsv.

# Rows tab.tbn.* and tab.tbx.* (line CLI, C2b): TBLASTN and TBLASTX custom tabular reports, -outfmt "6|7|10|20 [delim=X] <fields>" with -subject: every identifier, alignment and taxonomy field, outfmt 7 comment lines, queries without hits, plus and minus frames (TBLASTX also minus query frames, qstart above qend) and gapped TBLASTN HSPs, the delim= forms, unknown and removed tokens, frames without a counts field, -query_loc and -subject_loc, TBLASTN -matrix BLOSUM45 -word_size 2 -comp_based_stats 0, TBLASTX -query_gencode 4 -db_gencode 4 (contract approved_db_gencode_deviation; TBLASTN -db_gencode with -subject is not a row, see the sa.arch.tbn comment) (inputs tests/db_search/tslice.fna, tab_tbn_q.faa, xslice.fna, tab_tbx_q.fna, ids/nucl.fna, tests/fasta/outfmt0/tblastx_code4_*); freeze them alone with run_oracle.py --freeze --only tab.tbn. / --only tab.tbx. The runs that stop (the delim=/ error, rc 1) are db.tab.tbn.* and db.tab.tbx.* in db_search_manifest.tsv (run_oracle.py cannot freeze a non-zero exit).

# Rows ungapped.* (line NP, O4a-1): blastn -ungapped with -subject (outfmt 0, 5, 7, 13, 14, 15, 16; outfmt 8, 9, 11, 12 and 17 are refused until O4a-2); inputs tests/fixtures/blastn_regression/inputs/. Freeze them alone with run_oracle.py --freeze --only ungapped.

# Rows bxfast.* (line DI2, dropin-survey-20261029): BLASTX -task blastx-fast (api/blast_options_handle.cpp:429-433) with -subject: its defaults in outfmt 0, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 11, ABRicate's and Galaxy's calls, -word_size 3 and 5, -threshold, -window_size and the options next to the task; freeze them alone with run_oracle.py --freeze --only bxfast.
# Rows sp.* (dropin DI-7): -searchsp with -subject (the five programs); freeze them alone with run_oracle.py --freeze --only sp.

# Rows minraw.* (DI-6b): BLASTN -min_raw_gapped_score with -subject, four tasks, values below and above the cutoff of the e-value, 0, a negative value, -evalue 0, -ungapped and -xdrop_ungap. Freeze them alone with run_oracle.py --freeze --only minraw.

# Rows xdrop.* (DI-6): BLASTN -xdrop_ungap, -xdrop_gap, -xdrop_gap_final, -window_size, -off_diagonal_range and -no_greedy with -subject (pyani ANIb's call in xdrop.anib.*; inputs tests/fasta/outfmt0/anib_frags*.fna are 1020-nt fragments of tests/fasta/MelaMJNV.fasta, pyani's fragment size). Freeze them alone with run_oracle.py --freeze --only xdrop.
